title: fix(cli): serialize chat turns to preserve follow-up context
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16617

- Serializes accepted chat turns so follow-ups include preceding assistant replies. Drains queued turns before EOF autosave and stops queued work after explicit exit or fatal budget errors.
- Adds one regression test, "includes the preceding assistant reply in a quickly entered follow-up turn", in `packages/polli-cli/src/commands/gen/chat.test.ts`.
- Bumps the package to 0.1.31, with matching standalone lockfile metadata where present.
- Verified: the regression fails on `main` and passes with the fix; `npm test --silent`, `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` show no new problems.

`npx tsc --noEmit -p .` already fail on `main`; the fix adds no new failures.

_Found and fixed by Ribbert; manually refreshed and verified with Codex._

gist.headline: The bee remembers the conversation
gist.blurb: Quick follow-up messages keep the assistant’s reply in the conversation. Even the chat queue gets its turn before autosave.
gist.summary: Polli CLI 0.1.31 serializes accepted chat turns so quickly entered follow-ups include the preceding assistant reply, drains queued turns before EOF autosave, and stops queued work after exit or a fatal budget error.
gist.impact: CLI conversations retain the right context when users send follow-ups quickly, and queued turns finish before EOF autosave without continuing after an explicit exit or fatal budget error.
